title: CLEAR continues at Georgia State University
summary: The Civic Leadership Education and Research Initiative moved with its director to Georgia State University’s Andrew Young School of Policy Studies.
body_html:
CLEAR’s move to Georgia State University provides a new institutional home for its research on public-service workforces, administrative institutions, technology, and civic leadership.

At the Andrew Young School of Policy Studies, the initiative continues its student-centered research model while expanding connections to Atlanta’s public, nonprofit, civic, and private institutions.
